levels.surface: أبو علي محمد بن همام الإسكافي
أبو جعفر أحمد بن ما بندار

notes: Rule 11: Salim's own first-person account («قلت لأصحابي») is the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6); the Imam Abu Abd Allah speaks and acts inside the scene («فسكت أبو عبد الله عليه السلام ساعة، ثم قال») : whether he is transmitting or only in the scene is not settled, so he is not added
«7 -» and the opening «قال:» are not names; «قال رسول الله» inside the words is the Prophet, not a link
